pattern: ても始まらない（てもはじまらない）
purpose: Say that an action will not help move the situation forward.
keywords: Verb て-form + も始まらない
There is no use regretting it now.
Complaining will not help, so let us fix it.
Staying here worrying will get us nowhere.
formation: Verb て-form + も始まらない
restrictions: Often discourages worrying, complaining, or dwelling on the past.
mistake: It means there is no point, not that an event literally cannot begin.
